lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Hi, No.7!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: From now on, I will go to the surface with you,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: if you'd let me.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: We'll go on assignments

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: and do all kinds of random stuff together, right?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: That's all.
Why are you asking me this all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Well... That's because

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: the people up there are bored or something.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I'm asked to send

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: my Commander

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: a message saying that I'll be with you.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: They say it's a kind of new procedure or something.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Ugh... Just thinking about that

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: makes me wanna quit my job.
If it's really that upsetting, you don't have to follow it.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Nope, that's impossible.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Since I'm working in the office,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: shouldn't I be following the rules?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: There are consequences to not following procedures.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: So it's better for me to send you a message, isn't it? :)
I appreciate it.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: It's no big deal.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Besides, I wouldn't call it troublesome

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: since I get to be in touch with you, No. 7.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I mean, it depends.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: It wouldn't be bad if I saw a funny guinea pig :3
So should I be thanking you?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Well, I don't think so?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Ah, I'm sleepy.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I'm feeling sleepier after typing the word "sleepy."

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I have to go.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: It's going to be more of a problem if I get sleepy.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No more replies starting now ;)
That quick?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Yep, that's it. Don't reply to me again!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I'm so tired already. I don't want to type anymore.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Bye!
